title: The Intelligence Bound: Lean 4 Formalization of the Conditional Mathematics
description: Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the conditional mathematics in "The Intelligence Bound: Thermodynamic Limits on Learning Rate and Implications for Biosphere Information" (Hart 2025): 9 results, no sorry, standard axioms only. The thermodynamic arm is the assumed premise SatisfiesLandauerLimit (P >= dI/dt * k_B T ln 2); it is passed in as a hypothesis, not derived. The physical bound is a conjecture. Lean checks the implications from the stated premises, not that any physical learner satisfies them.
